decisions.reason: Selecting 286R as the document designation does not change the supplied site dates or their application to all date fields.
The designation decision does not change the existing $16,200 allocated-budget value or its basis.
Using 286R as the document designation does not provide a contract ID or change the recorded missing-ID statuses, which the candidate's same-message Event already captures.
The document designation does not alter the independently stated rule to place budget differences only in approved non-personnel lines.
The designation choice does not change the seven-week Annex B requirement.
The designation decision supplies no new session weekdays or time slots and does not modify the existing schedules.
The required subcontractor signature placement remains unchanged by the site document designation.
Choosing 286R for another site's document does not affect the established equivalence between NCA and NH.
The document designation does not change the session-based compensation formula or any personnel calculation values.
